:::{#exm-cross-product-matrix}
#### A cross-product matrix

Let $\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$
and $\matr{B} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix}$.
Then $\tprod{\matr{A}}{\matr{B}}$ is $2 \times 1$, and

$$
\ba
\tprod{\matr{A}}{\matr{B}}
&= \begin{bmatrix} \vecf{a}_1 \cdot \vecf{b}_1 \\ \vecf{a}_2 \cdot \vecf{b}_1 \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(@def-cross-product-matrix)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 1 + 2 + 0 \\ 0 + 2 + 3 \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(multiply and add)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 3 \\ 5 \end{bmatrix}.
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

:::
